_note: An RPL/IPv6 network of two emulated ESP32-C6 motes in this tab: node 1 runs Contiki-NG's rpl-udp server and is the DAG root, node 2 the client. The client joins the DAG, then sends a UDP request every 10 s and gets a reply — 6LoWPAN, RPL Lite and CSMA end to end over the emulated 802.15.4 MAC, hardware ACKs included. Both images are github.com/joakimeriksson/contiki-ng-esp32 (-DCONTIKI_UDP_SERVER=ON for the root). bb_init is the PHY blob's baseband calibration; each image has its own address for it.
